description: Implementation of the VideoEncoderFallback class, managing fallback logic for video encoding, including initialization, encoding, option changes, and fallback procedures.

classes.name: VideoEncoderFallback
classes.description: A class that provides a fallback mechanism for video encoding, switching encoders if the primary fails.

methods.name: VideoEncoderFallback
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fallback encoder with main encoder and fallback creation callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with profile, options, and callback functions.

methods.name: MakePendingEncode
methods.description: Creates a PendingEncode object with frame, options, and callback.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a video frame, using fallback if necessary.

methods.name: ChangeOptions
methods.description: Changes encoder options and output callback.

methods.name: FallbackInitialize
methods.description: Performs fallback initialization by creating a fallback encoder.

methods.name: CallInfo
methods.description: Calls the info callback with encoder info.

methods.name: CallOutput
methods.description: Calls the output callback with encoder output.
